content: Orot Iman Raguraguin auman
Namon Iesu imatabir men inai bayoi goai nan ato orot iman raguraguin auman min nan imama.
Sabu fani on nan sigogoi Iesu sitiubarai ato bobo komasis itfofour on; on mes osi sibinakikinai tiwag On mamaba ato orot nan Sabat ra itbiyawasai on.
Iesu orot raguraguin aurin iyau, “Om egai nin nawui etawar.”

Namon On sabu itetemis iyau, “Ot ati Baifafaro mamaba iyau ot ato Sabat ra nan bobo tanfofour aurin on? Orot tanibaisin o orot tanikomasai? Orot taniyawasai o orot tanirabobai?” Baise osi sabu on men abi dura tani siyau on.

Iesu irutabir osi ites on yan itatab ato baise On osi sabu auris iyababan mat yabin osi nunuas siwani kwakwan a eta mat sisarar. Namon On orot aurin iyau, “Om imam yotet egat.” On iman iyotet igat ato iyobin men.
On mes Pharisee yangan on bayoi goa sikirir sinai ato ra kaita Herod an sabu fani mat nan siruayo ato siyanu Iesu sitasubun mes.
Sabu Kuayo Gagamin Kamitai nan
Iesu an baigibubunuotis mat sinai au Galilee kamitai nan ato sabu kuayo gagamin on On sibigibubunuai. Osi sabu on Galilee tafanam emon, Judea tafanam emon sinat,

Jerusalem emon, Idumea tafanam emon, Jordan tafanam reban emon, mafam gagamis bisisi Tyre a Sidon emon sinat. Atonio osi sabuis kuayo gagamin on engon tutufin sinat Iesu aurin yabin osi On duran sitatam on bobo buburis ifofouren.
Sabu siruruayo on kuayo irat bag on mes Iesu an baigibubunuotis iyawures wa sitboai sitbotitiwag onai On men sabu mat sitikikin mes.
Iesu on sabu sigaraba maiau iyawasis ato osi sabu iyabon sawauis on sibirukokouen asi eta sibiyamai Iesu aurin sirur usin sitbotobon mes.
Ato sabu on nan osi iyabon ayu komasis tefasi simama, osi siyeit Iesu si’tai on nan nanai sifefeu ato sibiyoku si’yau, “Om on God Natun!”
Iesu dura wawaninai nan ayu komasis iyawures osi men sitkason On on Iyafan.
Iesu Baiyoyobotis Auyotoat Sasagis Ruam Irubinis
Namon Iesu inai oyauai igai ato On an gogoi sabu on iyores. Osi On aurin sinat,
ato On sabu auyotoat sasagis ruam irubinis, iwabis baiyoyobotis. On iyawures iyau, “Omi arubinem on Yau au baiyoyobotim mes wonmatar. Mat Yau arimon omi aniyafarem wongat dura wonbino,
ato omi arimon ami baibad wonboai dau wonfaitanis singat.”
On atonio osi sabu auyotoat sasagis ruam irurubinis on: Simon (Iesu wabin itai, Peter);
James tain John rus, (Iesu wabis ites on, Boanerges, on an yabin min, “Wanferer sabuis”);
Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James, Alphaeus natun, Thaddaeus, Simon, tafanam an rufafar orot,
Judas Iscariot, on Iesu ikaseirai.
Iesu a Beelzebul
Namon Iesu inai au go. Ato sabu kuayo gagamin bag on nan siruayo men ato Iesu an baigibubunuotis mat on auris wera men fofonin arimon bayu sitam on.
Iesu taitain on duran sitatam ato sigat sitboai mes yabin sabu on si’yau, “On ikokok!”
Baifafaro an baibebeotis fani osi Jerusalem emon sinat on si’yau, “On Orot on Beelzebul tefanai emama! Dau asi aiwab on faiwar ebitai on mes On dau efafaitanis segat.”
On mes Iesu on sabu iyores sinat aurin ato dura kawenai auris ikakafun iyau, “Mamaba arimon Afaguban on toun turan Afaguban infaitan ingat?
Tafanam ato toun wat itkuseseb itiyamai kuayo matas matas sitmatar weie tous wat sitigagam on tafanam min arimon engon ittumai itsawar.
Ato goa amonai taitais tutuas mat tous wat amosi sitkuseseb kuayo matas matas sitmatar weie tous wat sitigagam, on goa amonai taitais tutuas mat min arimon sittumai itsawar.
On mes ato Afaguban an baiaiwab itkuseseb kuayo matas matas, on men arimon iten on, ab arimon ittumai itan au kanfoun itsawar.
“Men iyafan tani orot wawanin an goa inaseb inar an sawar inbainau, ab on ainau on orot wawanin on inous tatan; weie on an goa inyakeai.
Yau awurem dura bag sabu asi bobo komasis sinfofour a asi dura komasis God aurin sinbikakafun on arimon innotbures.
Baise iyai iyafan dura komasis Ayu Kakafotin aurin inbikakafun on God arimon men innotburai yabin on bokomas ifofour on arimon an yawas amonai on nana inen au wantoan.”
(Iesu atonio dura ikakafun yabin sabu fani si’yau, “On dau tefanai emama.”)
Iesu Ayon a Taitain
Namon Iesu ayon a taitain sinat. Osi goa kounai sitawar ato dura wat siyafar irui aurin sitetem.
Sabu kuayo on Iesu sikufifinai simair simama ato osi siyawur siyau, “Eite ayom, taitaim a rorobum on goa kounai setatawar, ato osi segogoi Om sinitem.”
Iesu iyafotes iyau, “Iyafan on Yau ayou? Iyabon on Yau taitaiu?”
On iyeit sabu sikufifinai simair simama on ites ato iyau, “Woit! Nin on Yau ayou, Yau taitaiu!
Iyai iyafan God an gogoi nanaba efofour on Yau taitaiu, Yau rorobu, Yau a’you.”
